content:
- name: Carry forward archived docs (/v/*)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # gh-pages 分支是「当前已部署站点」的账本：每次部署成功后由本
          # 工作流推回。首次运行分支尚不存在，跳过即可（幂等）。
          if git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin gh-pages; then
            git worktree add --detach gh-pages-tree FETCH_HEAD
            if [ -f gh-pages-tree/version.json ]; then
              echo "Previously published: $(node -p "require('./gh-pages-tree/version.json').version")"
            fi
            if [ -d gh-pages-tree/v ]; then
              mkdir -p dist/v
              cp -a gh-pages-tree/v/. dist/v/
            fi
          else
            echo 'No gh-pages branch yet — first deploy, nothing to carry forward.'
          fi

      - name: Snapshot this release under /v/{version}/
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          VERSION=$(node -p "require('./dist/version.json').version")
          if [ "$VERSION" = "dev" ]; then
            echo 'No git tag available (dev build) — skipping versioned snapshot.'
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ -e "dist/v/$VERSION" ]; then
            echo "/v/$VERSION/ already archived — version unchanged, skipping re-archive."
            exit 0
          fi
          # 按版本 base 重建一份文档：快照的资源与路由都指向自身路径，
          # 与主站互不干扰（直接拷贝旧 dist 会因 base/路由烘焙进 bundle
          # 而无法在 /v/{version}/ 下运行）。
          BABEL_ENV=development BUILD_DEMO=true pnpm exec vite build \
            --base="/haze-ui/v/$VERSION/" --outDir "dist/v/$VERSION"
          cp src/generated/version.json "dist/v/$VERSION/version.json"
          cp llms.txt llms-full.txt "dist/v/$VERSION/"
          echo "Archived /v/$VERSION/."
note: VersionedDocs: two steps between 'Build docs site' and configure-pages. (1) Carry forward the previous /v/* archives from the gh-pages ledger branch (skips gracefully on first run when the branch does not exist). (2) Archive THIS release under /v/{version}/ by rebuilding the docs with a versioned --base — a plain copy of the old dist cannot work because the base path and router baseUrl are baked into the bundle at build time (router would 404 on /v/... and index.html would load the CURRENT site's assets). Skips on dev builds (no tag) and when the version is unchanged (docs-only redeploy). All shell blocks validated with bash -n; full flow simulated for first-run / new-version / unchanged-version / dev scenarios; --base equals-form verified against the real vite 8 binary.

content:
- name: Record deployed tree on the gh-pages branch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # 账本更新：让下一次部署能取回本次的 /v/* 归档与根 version.json。
          # 在 deploy-pages 成功之后执行，部署失败时账本不超前于线上。
          cd dist
          git init -q -b gh-pages
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add -A
          git commit -qm "docs: deploy $(node -p "require('./version.json').version")"
          git push -qf "https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" gh-pages:gh-pages
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
note: VersionedDocs: gh-pages branch is a pure ledger mirroring the deployed artifact tree (deploy-pages serves from the artifact, the branch is never the serving source, so no Pages settings change). Runs after deploy-pages so a failed deploy never advances the ledger. Nested git init inside dist/ happens after upload-pages-artifact, so no .git ever lands in the served tarball.
